explication: pg_stat_ch is a PostgreSQL extension that captures per-query telemetry and exports raw events for analysis in ClickHouse, with OpenTelemetry export also represented in its runtime modules. The primary flow is PostgreSQL query hooks → bounded shared-memory queue → background worker → exporter → destination. Query normalization and shared query-text storage support capture and queueing; ClickHouse migrations define the raw-event schema and analytical views. Connections between core stages follow the README’s documented pipeline; exporter variants and some internal calls are supported by the source index, while unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
